blazematica.credits.1: Blazematica is a Horizon re-creation of Litematica. All credit for the idea and design goes to:
blazematica.credits.2: Litematica by masa (maruohon), github.com/maruohon/litematica, maintained by Sakura-Ryoko (github.com/sakura-ryoko/litematica)
blazematica.credits.3: Litematica Printer by aleksilassila, github.com/aleksilassila/litematica-printer (maintained by Sakura-Ryoko)
blazematica.credits.4: Horizon by the horizon-rust team, github.com/horizon-rust/horizon
blazematica.credits.5: File formats: Litematica (.litematic), Sponge/WorldEdit (.schem), MCEdit (.schematic), Mojang (structure .nbt)
blazematica.credits.6: No code was copied from Litematica or the printer; it is not made or endorsed by their authors.
blazematica.chat.menu_blocked: The menu opens over the game only: close the open screen first
blazematica.err.outside_world: the placement would reach outside the world (x and z %s to %s, y %s to %s)

blazematica.help.1: /blazematica list | load <name> | unload [all] | reload | folder | info
blazematica.help.2: /blazematica placements | select <n>|next|prev | show [on|off] | hide | lock [on|off] | unlock
blazematica.help.3: /blazematica origin here | origin <x> <y> <z> | move <dx> <dy> <dz> | rotate cw|ccw|180|none | mirror none|x|z

blazematica.help.6: /blazematica layer all | <coordinate> | above <coordinate> | below <coordinate> | range <a> <b> | up | down | here | axis x/y/z

blazematica.help.9: /blazematica highlight missing|wrong [on|off] | highlight item <item>|all | highlight off
blazematica.help.10: /blazematica printer on|off | air on|off | speed <ticks> | reach <blocks>
blazematica.help.11: /blazematica easyplace on|off | easyplace every <ticks> | easyplace air on|off: hold right click to place the block the schematic wants
blazematica.help.12: /blazematica credits: who made the original Litematica and its printer

blazematica.menu.load.load_here_tip: Places it at your feet (or click the file twice)
blazematica.menu.load.pick: Pick a file on the left. Put .litematic, .schem, .schematic and .nbt files into the schematics folder.
blazematica.menu.load.reload_tip: Loads the last schematic again where it was
blazematica.menu.pl.load_more_tip: Another schematic, as one more placement
blazematica.menu.pl.hide_tip: Hidden placements stay loaded but aren't drawn or printed
blazematica.menu.pl.lock_tip_1: Locked: it can't be moved, turned or mirrored
blazematica.menu.pl.lock_tip_2: (neither here, nor by commands or the tool)
blazematica.menu.pl.unload_tip: Removes this placement (the world stays as it is)
blazematica.menu.pl.move_mode_tip: Wheel, arrows and PgUp/PgDn move it in the world (N)
blazematica.menu.pl.tool_tip_1: Placement mode: left click selects the placement looked at,
blazematica.menu.pl.tool_tip_2: right click moves the selected one there, Alt+wheel moves it,
blazematica.menu.pl.tool_tip_3: Ctrl+wheel turns it. Ctrl+middle click switches the mode.
blazematica.menu.save.title: Area selection: two opposite corners of the box to save
blazematica.menu.save.name: Name
blazematica.menu.save.look_tip: The block you look at (/lm pos1, /lm pos2)
blazematica.menu.save.save_tip_1: Saves the area as a .litematic into the schematics folder
blazematica.menu.save.save_tip_2: (chunk by chunk, as they are loaded)
blazematica.menu.save.cancel_tip: Stops the save; nothing is written
blazematica.menu.save.tool_tip: Opens the Tool tab: which item, its reach, its controls
blazematica.menu.save.tool_hint: With the %s in hand: left click corner 1, right click corner 2.
blazematica.menu.save.note: Saves the blocks with their states, as Litematica reads them. Not saved: what is inside chests, sign texts and entities.
blazematica.menu.tool.title: Selection tool: %s
blazematica.menu.tool.off: Off: clicks with it break and use as usual
blazematica.menu.tool.in_hand: On, and in your hand: click blocks to set the corners
blazematica.menu.tool.on: On: take it in your main hand to select
blazematica.menu.tool.item: Item: pick one, type its id, or take the one in your hand
blazematica.menu.tool.held_tip: The item in your main hand becomes the tool
blazematica.menu.tool.help_1: Left click: corner 1. Right click: corner 2.
blazematica.menu.tool.help_2: Middle click: pick a corner. Alt+wheel: move it.
blazematica.menu.tool.help_3: Ctrl+wheel: grow or shrink where you look.
blazematica.menu.printer.note: Survival: the blocks must be in your hotbar. On servers, automatic placing may break rules or trip anti-cheat.
blazematica.menu.display.stats: Overlay: %s faces in %s sections, ~%s MiB video memory · radius %s blocks%s
blazematica.menu.mat.hud_tip: The list in the corner while playing (J)
blazematica.menu.mat.copy_tip: Copies the list as a table: paste it into a spreadsheet
blazematica.menu.mat.empty: No schematic loaded, or it needs no items.
blazematica.menu.mat.highlight_tip: Marks them through everything, however far
blazematica.menu.mat.only_tip: Click a row below to mark only that item, again to mark all

blazematica.help.14: /blazematica paste | paste status | paste cancel: builds the selected placement with /setblock (needs cheats or operator rights)
blazematica.help.15: /blazematica hover on|off: what should be at the block you look at, in the HUD
blazematica.err.paste_usage: /lm paste, /lm paste status or /lm paste cancel
blazematica.err.still_pasting: a paste is still under way (/lm paste cancel)
blazematica.err.paste_empty: nothing to paste in the shown layers
blazematica.chat.pasting: Pasting %s: the first block goes alone, to check that the server allows /setblock
blazematica.err.paste_gone: the paste stopped: its placement was unloaded
